title: North Carolina's 3rd Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 election for North Carolina's 3rd Congressional District pits incumbent Republican Rep. Greg Murphy against Democratic nominee Dr. Raymond Smith and Libertarian candidate Daniel Cavender. The district, which covers eastern North Carolina including the Outer Banks, Greenville, and Jacksonville, was redrawn in October 2025, adding Greene, Lenoir, Wayne, and Wilson counties. Murphy, a urologist first elected in a 2019 special election, has represented the district for seven years and is a supporter of President Donald Trump. Smith, a former state representative and decorated combat veteran, won the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, with 56.6% of the vote. Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Likely Republican,' though Democrats see the newly drawn district as slightly more competitive in a favorable national environment.
polling_note: No independent opinion polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Likely Republican.' Prediction markets (Polymarket, Kalshi) suggest Rep. Greg Murphy is heavily favored but these are not traditional scientific polls.

candidates.name: Greg Murphy
candidates.summary: Gregory Francis Murphy (born March 5, 1963) is an American politician and urologist serving as the U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 3rd congressional district since 2019. He previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2015 to 2019, where he was Senior Chair of Health Policy and authored the STOP Act to combat the opioid epidemic. Murphy was unopposed in the 2026 Republican primary and is campaigning on reducing the cost of living and improving community safety.

candidates.name: Raymond Smith
candidates.summary: Dr. Raymond Edward Smith Jr. (born October 15, 1961) is a former Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who represented the 21st district (Wayne and Sampson counties) from 2019 to 2023. A decorated U.S. Army combat veteran who served during the Persian Gulf War, Smith also worked as an educator, football coach, and transportation planner. He won the 2026 Democratic primary with 56.6% of the vote, defeating Allison Jaslow, and is running on a platform of lowering costs, expanding affordable healthcare, and improving public education and infrastructure.

candidates.name: Daniel Cavender
candidates.summary: Daniel Cavender is the Libertarian Party candidate for North Carolina's 3rd Congressional District in the 2026 general election. He was previously a candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 30 in 2024. Cavender will appear on the November 2026 ballot alongside Republican incumbent Greg Murphy and Democratic nominee Raymond Smith.
